title.narrative: 1.2. INTEGRATED POLICIES FOR Early Child Development (ECD)

description.narrative: By 2016, Federal, State and Municipal government and social actors of 50% of the municipalities of the States in the Semiarid and Amazon Regions, and large urban centres enrolled in the Urban Centre Platform, are using methodologies and tools to promote early childhood policies and are implementing an Integrated Policy for Early Child Development (ECD) prioritising actions aimed at accelerating the reduction of maternal and neonatal mortality and early pregnancy.
